onboarding.title: Welcome to Bondhu
onboarding.subtitle: Your partner in personal growth. Let's start with your name.

landing.eyebrow: A free wellness companion for students and young professionals
landing.body: Feeling stuck with career choices, academic pressure, or just life in Dhaka? Bondhu connects you with mentors, tools, and a community that understands your journey.
landing.heroImageAlt: Students studying together at a table

mentors.title: Mentorship
mentors.body: Explore sessions with mentors who understand the Bangladeshi context, from BCS prep to corporate burnout.

wellness.title: Holistic wellness
wellness.body: Mental health is not a weakness. Track your mood daily and use breathing tools to calm anxiety before exams.

habits.title: Gamified habits
habits.body: Build discipline one day at a time. Complete daily quests, earn XP, and grow your streak.

reminders: Small steps every day still move you forward.
It's okay to rest. Rest is part of the journey.
Your worth is not measured by a single exam result.
Asking for help is a sign of strength.
